description: This file defines the server-side code-behind for a Razor Page used to edit catalog items within an admin interface. It manages the retrieval and submission of catalog item data, secured with authorization for administrators.

classes.name: EditCatalogItemModel
classes.description: Page model class handling the editing of catalog items for admin users, including GET and POST handlers.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to populate the page with existing catalog item data.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the catalog item asynchronously.
